target.definition: Number of registered company insolvencies in England and Wales in August 2026 as first reported in the Insolvency Service's monthly Company Insolvency Statistics release.

inputs.name: annual_insolvencies_2025
inputs.description: Total registered company insolvencies in England and Wales in calendar year 2025

provenance.rationale: Recent annual totals have run around 23-25k; 2025 assumed slightly below the 2023-24 peak.

inputs.name: annual_growth_factor
inputs.description: Factor by which the annual insolvency rate changes from 2025 to 2026

provenance.rationale: Insolvencies have been broadly flat to slightly rising; wide interval reflects macro uncertainty.

inputs.name: months_per_year
inputs.description: Number of months in a year

provenance.rationale: Calendar definition.

inputs.name: august_seasonal_factor
inputs.description: Ratio of the August monthly total to the average monthly total (accounts for summer holiday seasonality)

provenance.rationale: August typically sees lower insolvency counts due to holidays and court recess.

inputs.name: companies_register
inputs.description: Number of companies on the Companies House register in 2026

provenance.rationale: Register has grown to roughly 5.4 million companies.

inputs.name: annual_insolvency_rate
inputs.description: Annual insolvency rate per company on the register

provenance.rationale: Implied by ~23k insolvencies against ~5.4m companies.

inputs.name: monthly_share_of_annual
inputs.description: Share of annual insolvencies occurring in August

provenance.rationale: August is slightly below 1/12 of the year; 0.92/12 ≈ 0.0767.

inputs.name: uk_gdp
inputs.description: UK nominal GDP in 2026

provenance.rationale: UK GDP is roughly 2.8-3.0 trillion USD.

inputs.name: insolvency_gdp_share
inputs.description: Annual insolvency count per unit of nominal GDP

provenance.rationale: Calibrated so that ~23k insolvencies correspond to ~2.9e12 USD GDP.

inputs.name: august_gdp_share
inputs.description: Share of annual GDP generated in August

provenance.rationale: August is a full month, roughly 1/12 of annual output with minor holiday effect.

paths.description: Scale last year's annual total by growth and allocate to August using seasonal share.
Multiply the company register by the annual insolvency rate and the August share of the year.
Use nominal GDP as a proxy for economic activity and apply an insolvency intensity per unit of GDP.

problems: path p1: dimension mismatch: the formula gives count per time (s**-1), but the target needs a pure number, a count or a share (dimensionless). The formula has one 'per time' more than the target; inputs with a time unit in this path: months_per_year ('months'). If the target is a total over a period, multiply by an input whose unit is a length of time: the period itself (for example days_in_period with unit 'day'), or period_length = 1 with unit 'year' when a share of the year then picks the part you need. A share, or a ratio such as 'days/year', has no time unit and does not cancel it.
